text:
maria: Hey @kai @samir @leila — quick ping: PR #48210 touches authz header precedence + routing fallback. planning a canary merge Tue 11:30 PST, can you take quick eyes? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/48210

maria: TL;DR: small change in server/auth/middleware.go to prefer X-Authorized-Tenant then X-Tenant then JWT tid. Risk: header ordering could let legacy clients slip through if mis-ordered.

samir: @maria ok i'll look, do we need security signoff? pinging @leila

leila: @maria on it. quick q: does this change affect audit logs or header canonicalization? please add a short migration note in the PR.

maria: added a migration note and a rollback step to the PR. snippet i pushed:

```diff
- tenant := r.Header.Get("X-Tenant")
+ tenant := firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("X-Authorized-Tenant"), r.Header.Get("X-Tenant"), token.Claims["tid"])
```

maria: devops-bot ran a staging deploy, most tests green; one flaky load-test-eviction failing intermittently. ci link: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/48210

ops-bot: staging deploy succeeded in us-west-2 with 3/3 health checks. :white_check_mark:

leila: security scan flagged header normalization (ascii vs utf8). i can approve if we add normalizeHeader(...) + unit asserting normalized values.

kai: runtime note: this changes routing table population order. if cache keys include tenant header we should bump kv-cache version to avoid stale prefix mismatches. otherwise canary might route to wrong model shard.

maria: will add normalizeHeader + unit test + cache-version bump. who can own rollback for the canary? cc @samir

samir: i can be rollback owner for the canary window.

leila: once you push updates i'll rerun the security scan. ETA ~30m.

maria: pushed commits: added normalizeHeader, unit, cache bump, and short migration note. requesting review/approve when you can. target merge 11:30 PST.

kai: quick LGTM from runtime perf side. leaving infra/ops approve for deploy scheduling.

leila: security scan re-run: no high severity findings, low warnings cleared. :tada:

samir: LGTM from platform. i'll merge if no objections at 11:25.

maria: thanks all — tagging canary owners: @samir (rollback), @kai (runtime watch), @leila (sec). scheduling canary deploy at 11:30 PST.
